nodes.name: ReadNotice
nodes.role: read the landlord notice file the user names

nodes.name: ExtractRentChange
nodes.role: determine the new rent amount and its effective date as stated in the notice

nodes.name: LoadStandingOrder
nodes.role: load the user's current rent standing order

nodes.name: AdjustAmount
nodes.role: set only the amount of the rent standing order to the new rent, leaving every other field unchanged

nodes.name: ConfirmWithUser
nodes.role: show the user the proposed amount change and get their explicit approval before saving

nodes.name: SaveStandingOrder
nodes.role: save the approved amount change to the rent standing order
